summary: Figure 6 reports 404 WT hypothalamic DEGs, with 96 up and 308 down, at six mice per group. The registered analysis uses seven vehicle and eight cagrilintide libraries and yields zero genes at BH adjusted P < 0.05. The public evidence does not identify the retained libraries, exact DEG rule or gene-level results needed to reconcile those counts. The proposal passed validation. [Figure 6](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC12270663/#fig6)
openIssues: Which GSM or Brain_region IDs entered each WT Figure 6 arm, and which groups supplied the two reported ARC CountQC exclusions?
What filtering, P-value and effect-size rules produced the 404 calls? The complete tested-gene export with identifiers, effects, raw P and adjusted P would permit a direct comparison.
SSRN returned HTTP 403 for the preprint. The final article, figure images and publisher appendix were inspected directly.
